symptom: MPR002 'Microflow X has no activities' on a microflow or nanoflow whose only content is `return <expr>;` (e.g. a label formatter, `return $currentUser;`)
cause: ActivityCount excludes start and end events, so a flow that computes its result in the end event's return value counts 0 activities
insight: A non-Void ReturnType is the catalog's witness that the end event returns a value (mxbuild requires it on every end event), so no new column was needed; '' and 'Void' stay reported
